title: curvature
body:
## curvature

Computes per-point curvature of a polygonal surface (Gaussian or mean, the two curvature types ParaView 5.13.3 offers) as a point array such as Mean_Curvature or Gauss_Curvature. Use it to locate ridges, valleys or highly curved regions on CAD or scanned surfaces. Mean curvature is in inverse length units and Gaussian in inverse length squared; both are noisy on coarse or irregular triangulations. The mean-curvature sign assumes outward normals.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- type accepts only Gaussian or Mean, the entries of ParaView 5.13.3's Curvature enumeration (filters_filtersgeneral.xml:445-485); maximum and minimum principal curvature are not available and any other value is rejected at planning.
- If convex regions show negative mean curvature, the normals point inward; set invertMean.

Native constructor: `Curvature`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | This property specifies which type of curvature to compute. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Gaussian","Mean"]}` | `"Mean"` | `"Mean"` |
| `invertMean` | If this property is set to 1, the mean curvature calculation will be inverted. This is useful for meshes with inward-pointing normals. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "curvature",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
